import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        final int MAX = 10005;
        int[] t = new int[MAX];
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int m = sc.nextInt();
            t[m]++;
        }
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        // Compute prefix sums up to 3000
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3000; i++) {
            t[i] += t[i-1];
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i + k <= 5000; i++) {
            ans = Math.max(ans, t[i+k] - t[i-1]);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
